pages.intent: listed peer multiples the valuation is read from, and whether Falcon's profile lets the median apply
pages.message: Peers trade in a tight EBITDA multiple band; Falcon's margin and growth sit at the peer median; revenue multiples are margin in disguise

exhibits.reader_must_see: every peer's multiples, size and profile with the median and Falcon's growth and margin underneath
exhibits.comparison: each peer against the set's statistics, and Falcon's operating profile against the peers
exhibits.data: eight peers by eleven columns of market data, multiples and operating ratios, plus four statistic rows and the Falcon row

forms_considered.form: full comps table with statistics block
forms_considered.reason: chosen: the client checks every figure and the house style is the ruled comps table

forms_considered.form: ranked bar chart of EV / EBITDA
forms_considered.reason: the eight multiples sit within 0.9x, bars would look equal and hide the other columns

exhibits.chosen_form: full comps table with statistics block
exhibits.why: a lookup exhibit: values are checked row by row, and the statistics block is what the valuation applies
exhibits.marks: median row bold, mean high low italic, Falcon row shaded with navy bold text as on sheet 6 of the template
exhibits.in_reference_look: the template's listed peers table: unfilled header, hairline rules, shaded subject row

exhibits.reader_must_see: that EV / revenue rises in a straight line with EBITDA margin and where Falcon's margin falls on that line
exhibits.comparison: each peer's revenue multiple against its margin, and Falcon's margin against the fitted line
exhibits.data: eight pairs of margin and revenue multiple, correlation 0.99, plus one Falcon margin

forms_considered.form: scatter with fitted line and Falcon margin line
forms_considered.reason: chosen: the relationship and Falcon's position read at once

forms_considered.form: two ranked bar charts, margin and revenue multiple
forms_considered.reason: the reader would have to match names across charts to see the link

exhibits.chosen_form: scatter with fitted line and Falcon margin line
exhibits.why: the point is a relationship between two measures, which a scatter shows directly
exhibits.marks: a dashed orange vertical line at Falcon's 18.9% labelled with the multiple it implies on the fit
exhibits.in_reference_look: navy markers, grey dashed fit, orange threshold line with its own label as on the template's hurdle line

exhibits.reader_must_see: Falcon's margin, growth and size against the peer quartiles with its rank
exhibits.comparison: Falcon against the peer 25th percentile, median and 75th percentile on four measures
exhibits.data: four measures, each with Falcon value, three peer statistics and a rank

forms_considered.form: small table with Falcon column shaded
forms_considered.reason: chosen: four measures in different units read best as figures

forms_considered.form: dot plots per measure
forms_considered.reason: four separate scales take more room than the panel has for little gain

exhibits.chosen_form: small table with Falcon column shaded
exhibits.why: mixed units and only four rows; the figures are the point
exhibits.marks: Falcon column shaded with navy bold text; rank column states the position in words

exhibits.reader_must_see: that all eight peers trade at nearly the same EBITDA multiple
exhibits.comparison: each peer's EV / NTM EBITDA against the others and the median, on an axis from zero
exhibits.data: eight multiples between 11.1x and 12.0x and their median 11.4x

forms_considered.form: ranked horizontal bars from zero with a median line
forms_considered.reason: chosen: equal-looking bars are the honest picture of a tight band

forms_considered.form: dot plot on a truncated axis
forms_considered.reason: a truncated axis would make a 0.9x spread look wide

exhibits.chosen_form: ranked horizontal bars from zero with a median line
exhibits.why: the claim is that the spread is small; bars from zero show it without exaggeration
exhibits.marks: a navy median line labelled with its value; values inside each bar
exhibits.in_reference_look: grey bars with values at the base and a labelled navy line, as the template's reference multiples chart

pages.intent: announced deals in the sector and what buyers paid
pages.message: Sponsors paid 12.9x against 11.1x for strategics; the precedent median of 11.9x is below where peers trade today and no deal is Falcon's size

exhibits.reader_must_see: each deal's date, parties, size and multiples with the medians by buyer type
exhibits.comparison: each deal against the set's statistics and sponsor buyers against strategic buyers
exhibits.data: eight deals by nine columns including derived target EBITDA and margin, plus six statistic rows

forms_considered.form: precedents table with statistics and buyer-type medians
forms_considered.reason: chosen: lookup of each deal, as in the template's precedent table

forms_considered.form: timeline of deals
forms_considered.reason: there is no time trend to show and it hides the multiples

exhibits.chosen_form: precedents table with statistics and buyer-type medians
exhibits.why: readers look up and check individual deals; the medians by buyer type carry the claim
exhibits.marks: median bold, mean high low italic, the two buyer-type medians shaded
exhibits.in_reference_look: the template's precedent table with medians by buyer type

exhibits.reader_must_see: that sponsor deals cluster at the top of the multiple ranking and that most deals sit below today's trading multiple
exhibits.comparison: each deal's EV / LTM EBITDA against the others and against listed peers' current LTM median
exhibits.data: eight multiples from 9.8x to 13.8x, three sponsor and five strategic, plus one reference value 12.4x

forms_considered.form: ranked horizontal bars coloured by buyer type with a reference line
forms_considered.reason: chosen: rank, buyer type and the trading reference read together

forms_considered.form: columns in date order
forms_considered.reason: date order shows no pattern and scatters the buyer split

exhibits.chosen_form: ranked horizontal bars coloured by buyer type with a reference line
exhibits.why: the claim is about rank by buyer type and the gap to trading levels
exhibits.marks: sponsor bars navy and strategic grey, an orange dashed line at the listed peers' 12.4x labelled
exhibits.in_reference_look: the template's reference multiples bars with labels inside and a labelled vertical line

exhibits.reader_must_see: that bigger deals tended to price higher and Falcon sits beyond the largest deal
exhibits.comparison: each deal's EV against its EBITDA multiple, by buyer type, against Falcon's implied EV
exhibits.data: eight pairs of deal EV and multiple, correlation 0.57, plus one Falcon EV of $3,284m

forms_considered.form: scatter of deal EV against multiple with a Falcon EV line
forms_considered.reason: chosen: shows the size pattern and Falcon's position outside the set

forms_considered.form: two medians above and below $2,000m in a table
forms_considered.reason: hides the scatter and how weak an eight-point pattern is

exhibits.chosen_form: scatter of deal EV against multiple with a Falcon EV line
exhibits.why: a relationship between two measures reads directly on a scatter, and the reader can judge its strength
exhibits.marks: orange dashed line at Falcon's EV labelled with the figure; sponsor deals navy, strategic grey with a legend

pages.intent: every method's implied EV range on one scale, with the arithmetic behind it
pages.message: EBITDA methods give $3,002m to $3,530m and overlap at $3,396m to $3,457m; revenue methods are wider and secondary; equity value awaits net debt

exhibits.reader_must_see: where each method's implied EV range sits on one scale and where the EBITDA methods agree
exhibits.comparison: six methods' interquartile EV ranges and medians against each other
exhibits.data: six low, median and high EV triples between $2,779m and $3,639m

forms_considered.form: football field of floating bars with median breaks
forms_considered.reason: chosen: the standard banker's view of ranges on one axis

forms_considered.form: dot and whisker plot
forms_considered.reason: reads the same but departs from what a client expects on a valuation page

exhibits.chosen_form: football field of floating bars with median breaks
exhibits.why: ranges on one scale are the comparison; floating bars show overlap directly
exhibits.marks: EBITDA methods navy, revenue grey; a pale band over the overlap of the EBITDA ranges with a callout naming it; range figures beside each bar
exhibits.in_reference_look: navy and grey bars as in the template's charts, values beside the bars, no gridlines

exhibits.reader_must_see: the metric, multiples and implied EV behind each bar, and that equity value is open
exhibits.comparison: each method's multiples and implied EV at three points
exhibits.data: six methods by Falcon metric, three multiples, three EVs and a cross-check multiple, plus net debt and equity rows left open

forms_considered.form: implied value table with median column shaded
forms_considered.reason: chosen: the arithmetic must be checkable

forms_considered.form: notes under the chart
forms_considered.reason: prose hides the figures a reviewer recomputes

exhibits.chosen_form: implied value table with median column shaded
exhibits.why: the client will recompute the bars; a table shows every input
exhibits.marks: median EV column shaded and bold; placeholder rows italic

exhibits.reader_must_see: what the overlap of the EBITDA ranges means as multiples of each Falcon metric
exhibits.comparison: the two ends of the overlap restated on four Falcon metrics
exhibits.data: two EVs divided by four Falcon metrics

forms_considered.form: small two-column table
forms_considered.reason: chosen: eight figures the client will quote

forms_considered.form: sentence in the commentary
forms_considered.reason: eight figures in prose are hard to find again

exhibits.why: lookup figures in mixed metrics belong in a table
exhibits.marks: none: a reference table of eight figures with its heading saying what it restates
